summary_1line: Hanuman strategically warns Angada that rebellion will fail, urging him to return to Sugriva and trust in his uncle’s goodwill.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands before Prince Angada and the gathered monkeys, sternly warning him while pointing toward the distant mountains as he speaks of Lakshmana’s unstoppable arrows.
Hanuman describes Lakshmana’s lightning-like arrows shattering a mountain cave where Angada hopes to hide.
